_about: Step B2 of docs/photo-critic.md. What each category's photographs are expected to show, as sentences an image-text model compares a photograph against. One key per category in app/src/lib/categories.ts (data/test/photo-eval-prompts.test.mjs holds them in step). English, because the candidate models (SigLIP 2, CLIP) were trained on English captions; written for Vietnamese and Melbourne places, the two catalogs there are. A category scores a photograph by its best-matching sentence, so a sentence is added for a kind of photo the category has, not to weight it. Every category but focus, views and heritage gained a sentence for its front or entrance after the first full run (16 Oct 2026): a cover is an establishing view, and with only cafes describing one, 132 covers came out off-topic. Heritage already had one; a views place is shown from its terrace, and a focus place is a cafe whose front is a cafe's.
